logp.method_description: Lipophilicity, commonly expressed log P (the partition coefficient of a compound in two immiscible phases, as water and n-octanol). Water-octanol partition coefficients were determined using the shake flask method [41b]. The determination was carried out at in a mixture of equal volumes of water and n-octanol, and continuously shaking for 18 h at room temperature. The concentrations of complexes in n-octanol and water were measured spectrophotometrically in order to determine values of P = [compound]n-octanol/[compound]water.
